44103071.article_content:
We’re excited to announce the release of
Stalwart v0.12
, a significant milestone that evolves Stalwart from a powerful mail server into a complete, integrated
communication and collaboration platform
. This release delivers one of the most anticipated features from our community:
native support for calendars, contacts, and file storage
—all built directly into the server, with no need for third-party integrations.
Calendars, Contacts & Files – All in One Place
​
With v0.12, you no longer need to integrate third-party groupware solutions or run parallel systems to support collaboration. Stalwart now includes first-class support for
CalDAV calendars
,
CardDAV contacts
, and
WebDAV-based file storage
. This means users can manage their events, address books, and documents through any standards-compliant client, seamlessly connected to the same backend that handles their email.
Shared resources such as
group calendars
,
shared address books
, and
team-accessible file folders
are also fully supported, providing a robust foundation for collaboration without the need for external software or services. And, to support flexible collaboration, Stalwart includes full support for the
WebDAV Access Control List (ACL) extension
, enabling detailed, per-user and per-group permission management.
Improved Spam Filtering
​
Another thoughtful addition in this release is the integration of the spam filter with users’ personal address books. Messages from known or trusted contacts are now far less likely to be incorrectly flagged as spam. And if a legitimate message does get misclassified, the system automatically trains the
Bayesian classifier
to treat future similar messages as legitimate, improving accuracy over time without additional user intervention.
Performance Enhancements
​
Under the hood, Stalwart v0.12 introduces several key performance optimizations designed especially for
large, multi-node environments
. One of the most impactful changes is the introduction of
incremental caching
: Stalwart now keeps account metadata in memory and only fetches updates when something changes in the database. This significantly reduces load and speeds up response times.
Another major enhancement is the use of
zero-copy deserialization
. This means Stalwart can read data directly from memory buffers without copying it into new structures, lowering CPU usage and improving throughput. Combined with optimizations that reduce the number of required
database queries
for common operations, these changes result in a leaner, faster backend that scales much more efficiently.
While these gains may not be noticeable in smaller setups,
larger clusters and high-volume deployments will see noticeable performance improvements
.
Smarter and Faster Clustering
​
We’ve also made big strides in
cluster coordination
. Previously, Stalwart relied on a UDP-based gossip protocol that performed well but didn’t scale ideally under heavy workloads. With v0.12, cluster behavior is now adaptable based on deployment size.
In
small deployments
, Stalwart uses
Eclipse Zenoh
, a lightweight and efficient peer-to-peer pub/sub protocol. For
larger infrastructures
, you can now choose from robust, scalable backends like
Apache Kafka
,
Redpanda
,
NATS
, or
Redis
for handling inter-node coordination, state synchronization, and workload distribution.
Looking Ahead: What’s Next?
​
With Stalwart v0.12, we're delivering more than just features—we're delivering
freedom from fragmented infrastructure
. No more patching together third-party services to get the basics of collaboration working. Now, everything—
email, calendars, contacts, files, and sharing
—lives in a single, efficient, and secure system.
While v0.12 is a major leap forward, we’re already preparing additional enhancements for the next point release. In
v0.12.1
, you can expect support for
CalDAV Scheduling (RFC 6638)
, enabling automatic meeting invitations and attendee responses. We’re also adding support for
event notification alerts via email
, so users are always aware of upcoming events, even if they're not logged into their calendars.
Additionally, in the coming months, we will be releasing support for the
JMAP for Calendars
,
JMAP for Contacts
, and
JMAP for File Storage
extensions. JMAP offers a modern, efficient, and JSON-based alternative to legacy protocols, making it faster and easier to develop responsive, real-time collaboration tools. These additions will further streamline the user experience and reduce bandwidth and processing overhead across client-server interactions.
Thank you to everyone who contributed feedback, suggestions, and encouragement. We can’t wait to hear what you build with this release—and we’re just getting started.

主要讨论点：用户对浏览器开发、功能更新及透明度的不同看法，特别是围绕Arc浏览器和Dia浏览器的讨论。

不同观点：
• [ko_pivot] 认为多空间（Space）功能是Arc浏览器的核心特色，但只有5.52%的日常活跃用户经常使用多空间，这让他感到惊讶。
• [WoodenChair] 对Dia浏览器从架构上优先考虑性能表示关注，特别是提到了停止使用TCA和SwiftUI，以保持Dia的轻量和快速响应，但对TCA是什么表示疑问。
• [rado] 喜欢垂直标签页功能，并希望该功能能在Safari甚至Chrome中出现。
• [tolerance] 对Arc浏览器开发者的态度持批评态度，认为其过于严肃且缺乏说服力。
• [twohaibei] 提到Arc浏览器在更新到manifest v3后，uBlock Origin插件无法使用，因此转向了Zen Browser。
• [nsonha] 没有使用Dia浏览器，但尝试过与Arc类似的Deta Surf浏览器，认为其AI集成更好，可以在同一个工作空间内引用标签页并与AI交流。
• [al_borland] 对Arc浏览器停止开发新功能并进入仅支持模式表示不满，认为缺乏透明度。他对文章中提到的“将软件维护得很好”持怀疑态度，认为浏览器需要持续进化，停留在安全更新和修复bug是不够的。他还指出，文章与实际行动的不一致性削弱了用户对开发者的信任。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Arc浏览器停止开发新功能的决定以及透明度问题。一些用户认为开发者没有充分告知用户这一决定，导致用户感觉被“欺骗”。
• 用户对Dia浏览器的性能改进表示关注，但对Arc浏览器的经验使得他们对Dia持保留态度。
• 实验性浏览器在市场中的作用被认为是积极的，因为它们为新想法提供了试验平台，即便最终是由大公司采纳这些想法。

整体来看，用户对浏览器开发的持续性、功能进化以及开发者的透明度有较高期望，并对实验性浏览器的市场定位提出质疑。

• 争议的焦点在于Arc浏览器停止开发新功能的决定以及透明度问题。一些用户认为开发者没有充分告知用户这一决定，导致用户感觉被“欺骗”。
• 用户对Dia浏览器的性能改进表示关注，但对Arc浏览器的经验使得他们对Dia持保留态度。
• 实验性浏览器在市场中的作用被认为是积极的，因为它们为新想法提供了试验平台，即便最终是由大公司采纳这些想法。

整体来看，用户对浏览器开发的持续性、功能进化以及开发者的透明度有较高期望，并对实验性浏览器的市场定位提出质疑。

data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: Clojure MCP 是一个处于早期开发阶段的 Alpha 软件，旨在通过 AI 辅助实现 Clojure 项目的 REPL 驱动开发。它提供一个 MCP 服务器，连接 AI 模型与 Clojure nREPL，并集成专用 Clojure 编辑工具，提升开发效率。主要功能包括 Clojure REPL 连接、Clojure 感知编辑（使用 clj-kondo、parinfer 等工具）、以及为 Clojure 开发优化的工具集。该项目强调即时反馈、增量开发、人工监督和函数式编程。安装需配置 Clojure、Java、Claude Desktop 等环境，并将 MCP 服务器与 nREPL 连接。项目可在本地运行，但目前需共享文件系统。用户可通过配置文件接入 Claude Desktop 实现 AI 辅助开发。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）助手在编程开发中的应用，特别是与状态性REPL（交互式编程环境）的结合及其在Clojure等语言中的效果和价值。

不同观点：
• **brucehauman**：认为将LLM助手与状态性REPL结合使用能极大提升开发效率。LLM可以自动生成代码、测试用例并即时执行，甚至能设置测试框架，自动进行代码测试和验证。这种体验非常棒，是一种极其有效的工作流。

• **rads**：对LLM工具持谨慎态度，认为Clojure社区重视代码的简洁性和深入理解，过度依赖LLM工具可能违背这些原则。虽然LLM在搜索和设计反馈方面有价值，但将代码上下文输入LLM可能过于耗时，因此更多地用于通用设计问题，而非具体代码问题。

• **danw1979**：支持使用LLM与IDE集成的方法，即使自己不是Clojure用户，也通过设置Jetbrains MCP服务器和Claude Desktop获得了良好的体验。建议通过系统提示让LLM获取项目上下文以提高反馈质量。

• **tosh**：认为REPL驱动的开发与当前的代理概念天然契合，并提到brucehauman之前开发的Figwheel工具（用于ClojureScript的热重载），暗示这种结合有历史渊源和技术基础。

• **makizar**和**cldwalker**：分享了一个演示视频，展示了REPL助手的实际应用，并对该方法在较大代码库中的效果表示好奇和关注。

• **mark_l_watson**：认为该工具填补了一个有用的 niche，但自己主要使用Gemini、OpenAI和本地模型，因此不适用。顺便提到Google Jules对Clojure开发有帮助，并设置提醒关注未来是否支持其他平台。

• **ihodes**：提出一种设想，希望有一个MCP可以连接到正在运行的前端页面（如Chrome标签），让代理既能视觉检查又能与页面交互，还能查看网络和控制台标签，认为这将非常有用。

• **fjalahdbtnt**：质疑为何要为聊天机器人使用桌面应用，认为API应该是首选。对使用Claude Desktop以避免API费用表示不解，认为这种做法不合理。

补充讨论：
- 对LLM在具体编程工作流中的实际效果存在不同看法，部分人（如brucehauman）非常看好其提升开发效率的能力，而其他人（如rads）则持怀疑态度，认为其对长期维护和代码理解可能有负面影响。
- 关于LLM工具的收费与使用便捷性存在争议，部分用户（如danw1979）认为Claude Desktop可以避免API费用并提高体验，但fjalahdbtnt则质疑这种做法的经济性。
- 对LLM工具在较大代码库中的适用性存在疑问，尤其是其在处理复杂项目时的表现如何，仍需进一步验证。

Clojure MCP - REPL-Driven Development with AI Assistance
⚠️
Alpha Software - Work in Progress
This project is in early development and rapidly evolving. While I've found it invaluable for working with Clojure projects and it has significantly improved my development workflow, expect breaking changes, rough edges, and incomplete documentation.
🤝 Help Wanted!
If you find this useful, please consider contributing:
Report bugs and issues you encounter
Suggest improvements or new features
Submit pull requests for fixes or enhancements
Share your configuration patterns and workflows
Help improve documentation and examples
Your feedback and contributions will help make this tool better for the entire Clojure community!
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Clojure that provides a
complete set of tools to aid in the development of Clojure projects.
🚀 Overview
This project implements an MCP server that connects AI models to a
Clojure nREPL, and Specialized Clojure editing tools enabling a unique
Clojure develop experience.
Clojure MCP provides a superset of the tools that Claude Code uses,
so you can use it to work on Clojure
without any other tools
.  I
highly recommend using it with Claude Desktop to start.  It's
prettier and there are
no api charges!
Claude Desktop also let's you
have quick access to
your own prompts
and other resources provided
by the clojure-mcp server. Having a stack of your own prompts
available in a UI menu is pretty nice.
Main Features
Clojure REPL Connection
Clojure Aware editing
- Using clj-kondo, parinfer, cljfmt, and clj-rewrite
Optimized set of tools for Clojure Development
superset of Claude Code
Emacs edit highlighting
- alpha
Why REPL-Driven Development with AI?
This approach enables:
Immediate feedback
- Validate code by running it in a stateful REPL, not just statically analyzing it
Incremental development
- Build solutions in small, verified steps
Human oversight
- Keep the programmer in the loop for guidance
Functional approach
- Encourage pure functions that are easier to understand and test
📋 Installation
Prerequisites
Clojure
(1.11 or later)
Java
(JDK 11 or later)
Claude Desktop
(for the best experience)
Setting up the project
Step 1: Get the Clojure MCP Server
Clone this repository to your development machine
git clone https://github.com/bhauman/clojure-mcp.git
or use it as git dep in your
deps.edn
{
:deps
{bhauman/clojure-mcp {
:git/url
"
https://github.com/bhauman/clojure-mcp.git
"
:git/sha
"
latest-main-branch-sha
"
}}
Step 2: Configure Your Target Project
In the Clojure project where you want AI assistance, add MCP server configuration to your
deps.edn
:
{
:aliases
{
;
; nREPL server for AI to connect to
:nrepl
{
:extra-paths
[
"
test
"
]
:extra-deps
{nrepl/nrepl {
:mvn/version
"
1.3.1
"
}
ch.qos.logback/logback-classic {
:mvn/version
"
1.4.14
"
}}
:jvm-opts
[
"
-Djdk.attach.allowAttachSelf
"
]
:main-opts
[
"
-m
"
"
nrepl.cmdline
"
"
--port
"
"
7888
"
]}
;
; MCP server configuration (for reference)
:mcp
{
:extra-deps
{org.slf4j/slf4j-nop {
:mvn/version
"
2.0.16
"
}
clojure-mcp/clojure-mcp {
:local/root
"
/path/to/clojure-mcp
"
}}
:exec-fn
clojure-mcp.main/start-mcp-server
:exec-args
{
:port
7888
}}}}
Important
: Replace
/path/to/clojure-mcp
with the actual path to your cloned repository.
IMPORTANT NOTE: the mcp server can run in any directory and DOES NOT
have to run in your project.  The mcp server looks to the nREPL
connection for context.  The root directory of the project that is
running the nREPL server becomes the root directory of all the mcp
tool invocations. Currently the nREPL must run on the same machine
as the MCP server as there is an assumption of a shared file system
between the nREPL server and the MCP server.
Step 3: Configure Claude Desktop
Edit your Claude Desktop configuration file:
Location
:
~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
{
"mcpServers"
: {
"clojure-mcp"
: {
"command"
:
"
/bin/sh
"
,
"args"
: [
"
-c
"
,
"
cd /path/to/your/clojure/project && PATH=/your/bin-or-nix/path:$PATH && clojure -X:mcp :port 7888
"
]
}
}
}
Replace these paths
:
/path/to/clojure-mcp

data.title: Rock, paper, scissors showdown
data.author: fidotron
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“石头剪刀布策略竞赛”的技术实现、游戏体验及具体策略的讨论。

不同观点：
• **srean的观点**：分享了自己在比赛中使用的策略，即通过压缩对手的历史出招记录来预测下一步动作，并将此策略与马尔科夫链和Lempel-Ziv压缩算法进行比较。他认为纯粹的纳什均衡策略缺乏趣味，而更复杂的模型如基于转换器的策略也未必是最优选择。他还提到在有限回合中，Lempel-Ziv压缩算法的优势未必能完全展现。

• **fidotron的观点**：作为比赛组织者之一，提供了比赛背后的技术细节，包括自定义WebGL2渲染器和FoundationDB的使用。他还解释了使用的5链马尔科夫链 ensemble 机制，强调这种方法比作弊更有趣。此外，他分享了相关资源供有兴趣的玩家参考。

• **guest__user的观点**：对游戏的视觉效果表示赞赏，并询问了游戏的编程或动画实现方式。

• **avodonosov的观点**：分享了自己的游戏统计数据，并对游戏中马尔科夫链学习机制的实际效果表示怀疑。他提到在不知道如何利用对手学习机制的情况下，依然能够赢得比赛。他还对游戏的摄像机抖动效果表示不满，并建议增加总积分统计功能。

• **sugarkjube的观点**：提到在24回合后感到无聊，并分享了自己利用对手历史记录进行反制的尝试，但承认难以长时间坚持这种策略。

• **ponco的观点**：提到一位总是赢得“石头剪刀布”比赛的同事，并猜测这可能与行为心理学或模式识别有关。

• **croemer的观点**：对游戏是否真的使用马尔科夫链表示怀疑，认为没有明确证据支持这一说法。

• **gnarlouse的观点**：分享了自己的游戏成绩，并以幽默的方式接受了自己的表现。

• **082349872349872的观点**：提到了香农1953年的相关工作，提供了一个外部链接供参考。

• **BrenBarn的观点**：除了马尔科夫链技术细节，还对游戏的图形和音乐效果表示了赞赏。

• **rkagerer的观点**：幽默地表示对比赛浪费了自己几分钟生命。

• **bArray的观点**：分享了自己的游戏成绩，并表示有信心能够继续进行比赛。

• **sweeter的观点**：分享了自己的最高 combo 和积分，并提到尝试通过条件反射来影响对手的策略。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于游戏是否真正使用了马尔科夫链学习机制，以及这种机制是否能够被玩家有效利用。
- 不同的玩家分享了各自的游戏策略和成绩，有些玩家尝试反制学习机制，而有些玩家则对游戏的视觉和音效表示赞赏。
- 技术细节如WebGL2渲染器和FoundationDB的使用引起了部分玩家的兴趣。

data.title: High strength bio-concrete for the production of building components
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种基于微生物诱导碳酸钙沉淀（MICP）的高强度生物混凝土，作为传统波特兰水泥混凝土的潜在替代品。生物混凝土在生物矿化过程中不产生二氧化碳排放，且能以碳酸盐形式固碳，具有CO2中和潜力。然而，实现与传统混凝土相当的抗压强度和足够的组件深度一直是挑战。研究通过使用尿素酶活性碳酸钙粉末（UACP）、优化骨料密实度、以及自动停止流压注射方法，测试了多种水泥化参数，最终达到52.5 MPa的抗压强度和140 mm的 cementation深度，这在以往研究中未见报道。研究结果显示，均匀密实和足够的骨料密实度是获得高质量水泥化的关键，这为生物混凝土用于预制承重建筑组件开辟了新可能性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：生物混凝土生产中的生态挑战及其潜在问题

不同观点：
• 正面观点：评论者认为生物混凝土技术听起来非常有趣且具有前景，表明了对该技术潜在优势的认可。
• 生态挑战观点：评论者指出生物混凝土生产过程中存在一些明显的生态挑战，包括合成尿素的高能量需求和废水径流问题，这显示了对环境影响的关注。
• 材料挑战观点：评论者提到了钙质生物混凝土对钢筋的腐蚀问题，由于氯化钙的使用，钢筋可能会受到腐蚀，因此需要使用耐腐蚀的增强材料，暗示了材料选择上的技术难题。

补充讨论：
• 技术可行性：评论中隐含了对生物混凝土技术可行性的讨论，特别是在解决材料腐蚀和能量需求方面的技术难题后，该技术才能更具应用前景。
• 争议焦点：生物混凝土的环境效益和技术挑战之间的权衡是争议的焦点，即尽管该技术具有前景，但其生产过程中产生的生态问题需要有效的解决方案。

High strength bio-concrete for the production of building components
Download PDF
Download PDF
Subjects
Biomaterials
Civil engineering
Structural materials
Abstract
The production of bio-concrete is based on the process of microbially-induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP), in which calcium carbonate (CaCO
3
) is formed as a binder. Bio-concrete is a potentially CO
2
-neutral alternative to conventional Portland-cement-based concrete, since no process-related carbon dioxide emissions are generated during biomineralization. Furthermore, CO
2
is bound in the form of carbonate. However, achieving compressive strength values comparable to conventional concrete, in combination with sufficient component depth, has been a significant challenge in the MICP research. In the present study, a combination of methods was implemented, including the use of urease-active calcium carbonate powder (UACP) instead of free bacterial cells, optimization of aggregate packing density, and the implementation of an automated stop-flow pressure injection method. A variety of cementation parameters were tested to determine the optimal conditions for the production of homogeneously cemented high strength bio-concrete. Additionally, reproducibility and optimization studies have been conducted with selected parameter combinations. It was found that achieving homogeneous compaction with sufficient aggregate packing density played a crucial role in obtaining consistent and high-quality cementation results. A combination of a very high compressive strength of 52.5 MPa and a cementation depth of 140 mm has been reached, which has not been reported in previous publications. These findings might unveil new possibilities for bio-concrete to be used in the production of prefabricated load-bearing building components, where it could partially replace traditional concrete.

Clinker substitution is often used to tackle the problem of process emissions, but this still falls within the traditional clinker-based cement paradigm.
Bio-concrete represents a different approach, in which aggregates are consolidated by calcium carbonate crystals produced through microbially-induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP). The biomineralization through MICP is CO

Bio-concrete has a chemical composition similar to calcite-cemented sandstone and can be shaped into various forms and reinforced, making it potentially suitable for the production of larger building components. By producing raw materials with renewable energy sources and circular economy principles, bio-concrete could, therefore, be considered a CO

data.title: Grammars of Formal Uncertainty
data.author: barthelomew
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化推理任务中的可靠性问题，重点研究了LLMs生成形式化规格时的失败模式和不确定性。通过对五种前沿LLMs的系统评估，研究发现基于Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) 的自动形式化在不同领域对准确性有显著影响（逻辑任务提高34.8%，事实任务下降44.5%）。已知的不确定性量化（UQ）技术无法有效识别这些错误。为此，文章引入了一种概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）框架，提出了新的不确定性分类法，并根据任务依赖的信号（如语法熵）进行选择性验证，显著减少错误率（14-100%），从而使LLM驱动的形式化成为可靠的工程实践。

View a PDF of the paper titled Grammars of Formal Uncertainty: When to Trust LLMs in Automated Reasoning Tasks, by Debargha Ganguly and 9 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) show remarkable promise for democratizing automated reasoning by generating formal specifications. However, a fundamental tension exists: LLMs are probabilistic, while formal verification demands deterministic guarantees. This paper addresses this epistemological gap by comprehensively investigating failure modes and uncertainty quantification (UQ) in LLM-generated formal artifacts. Our systematic evaluation of five frontier LLMs reveals Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) based autoformalization's domain-specific impact on accuracy (from +34.8% on logical tasks to -44.5% on factual ones), with known UQ techniques like the entropy of token probabilities failing to identify these errors. We introduce a probabilistic context-free grammar (PCFG) framework to model LLM outputs, yielding a refined uncertainty taxonomy. We find uncertainty signals are task-dependent (e.g., grammar entropy for logic, AUROC>0.93). Finally, a lightweight fusion of these signals enables selective verification, drastically reducing errors (14-100%) with minimal abstention, transforming LLM-driven formalization into a reliable engineering discipline.

data.title: Mesa3D Drivers for Windows
data.author: XzetaU8
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Windows平台上预构建的Mesa3D驱动程序项目（mesa-dist-win），包括下载、已知问题、安装使用方法和常见错误的解决方案。项目获得了赞助，提供了一台用于构建的VPS服务器。文章列出了多个已知问题，如某些DLL文件缺失错误，并提供了相应的修复方法，如重新部署应用或运行修复脚本。此外，还说明了Mesa版本更新带来的变化和环境变量配置问题，帮助用户解决驱动程序使用中的常见问题。64位二进制文件曾需要AVX支持的问题已修复，Mesa 22.0及更新版本不再有此问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenGL的现状及其在不同环境下的使用问题，尤其是在向Wayland和Vulkan过渡的过程中，如何处理遗留的OpenGL应用程序。

不同观点：
• **bno1的观点**：OpenGL在某些现代应用中仍然存在使用问题，例如在Windows 11的QEMU虚拟机中运行rekordbox时遇到的启动失败问题。bno1认为这是由于开发者未在无GPU加速的系统上充分测试应用所致。
  
• **sylware的观点**：OpenGL已经过时，Linux环境下仅在一些遗留的32位应用（如Steam客户端）中还需要使用。sylware指出，转向Wayland和Vulkan是更现代的选择，但遗留应用的兼容性处理工作量巨大。sylware还提到，尽管有Xwayland作为过渡方案，但维护和调试这个复杂的栈非常困难。sylware自己仍在使用Xorg，但正在编写自己的Wayland合成器以逐渐脱离X11。

• **nicman23的观点**：提出关于Lavapipe（软件渲染）和Virgl（利用主机GPU的虚拟化技术）在处理OpenGL应用时的适用性问题，询问是否仅Lavapipe就足够，还是需要Virgl来利用主机GPU。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现的复杂性**：sylware特别提到了从X11转向Wayland过程中技术栈的复杂性，尤其是Xwayland和GLX/GL栈的维护和调试难度，反映出开发者在处理遗留系统和现代系统过渡时的实际困难。

• **具体技术方案的讨论**：nicman23的问题引发了对具体技术方案的讨论，即Lavapipe和Virgl在处理OpenGL应用上的不同作用和适用场景，表明社区对实际解决方案的关注。

争议焦点：
• OpenGL作为遗留技术是否应继续支持，以及如何在现代系统（如Wayland和Vulkan）中高效兼容和处理遗留OpenGL应用，是讨论的主要争议点。sylware强调了过渡的复杂性和工作量，而nicman23则关注具体的实现方案。

44104008.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Windows平台上预构建的Mesa3D驱动程序项目（mesa-dist-win），包括下载、已知问题、安装使用方法和常见错误的解决方案。项目获得了赞助，提供了一台用于构建的VPS服务器。文章列出了多个已知问题，如某些DLL文件缺失错误，并提供了相应的修复方法，如重新部署应用或运行修复脚本。此外，还说明了Mesa版本更新带来的变化和环境变量配置问题，帮助用户解决驱动程序使用中的常见问题。64位二进制文件曾需要AVX支持的问题已修复，Mesa 22.0及更新版本不再有此问题。
44104008.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenGL的现状及其在不同环境下的使用问题，尤其是在向Wayland和Vulkan过渡的过程中，如何处理遗留的OpenGL应用程序。

不同观点：
• **bno1的观点**：OpenGL在某些现代应用中仍然存在使用问题，例如在Windows 11的QEMU虚拟机中运行rekordbox时遇到的启动失败问题。bno1认为这是由于开发者未在无GPU加速的系统上充分测试应用所致。
  
• **sylware的观点**：OpenGL已经过时，Linux环境下仅在一些遗留的32位应用（如Steam客户端）中还需要使用。sylware指出，转向Wayland和Vulkan是更现代的选择，但遗留应用的兼容性处理工作量巨大。sylware还提到，尽管有Xwayland作为过渡方案，但维护和调试这个复杂的栈非常困难。sylware自己仍在使用Xorg，但正在编写自己的Wayland合成器以逐渐脱离X11。

• **nicman23的观点**：提出关于Lavapipe（软件渲染）和Virgl（利用主机GPU的虚拟化技术）在处理OpenGL应用时的适用性问题，询问是否仅Lavapipe就足够，还是需要Virgl来利用主机GPU。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现的复杂性**：sylware特别提到了从X11转向Wayland过程中技术栈的复杂性，尤其是Xwayland和GLX/GL栈的维护和调试难度，反映出开发者在处理遗留系统和现代系统过渡时的实际困难。

• **具体技术方案的讨论**：nicman23的问题引发了对具体技术方案的讨论，即Lavapipe和Virgl在处理OpenGL应用上的不同作用和适用场景，表明社区对实际解决方案的关注。

争议焦点：
• OpenGL作为遗留技术是否应继续支持，以及如何在现代系统（如Wayland和Vulkan）中高效兼容和处理遗留OpenGL应用，是讨论的主要争议点。sylware强调了过渡的复杂性和工作量，而nicman23则关注具体的实现方案。

data.title: Bank transactions cleared by FTP-ing files
data.author: jv22222
data.article_summary: 文章主要指出，某些与隐私相关的浏览器扩展程序可能会导致在x.com（即推特）上出现问题。建议用户禁用这些扩展程序，然后重试访问网站，以解决可能出现的故障。文章提醒用户不必担心，只需按照提示操作即可。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：金融和技术行业中数据传输和协作方式的现状及其问题

不同观点：
• [drfunk] 对讨论主题感到情绪激动，暗示对现状的强烈反应。
• [kotaKat] 指出在医疗保健行业中也存在类似的现象，通过VPN和FTP传输文件，幸运的话可能会使用SFTP连接来传输HL7文件。
• [bobek] 描述了一家金融科技公司通过CSV导出、FTP或电子邮件传输、Excel验证，然后再导入到中心数据库的方式，导致了数据丢失问题。
• [johngladtj] 支持bobek的观点，表示在基金管理的后台操作中，文件传输故障是日常工作中的常见问题。
• [foobarkey] 提到在银行业中，(S)FTP集成是许多操作的基础，尤其是与合作伙伴银行的SWIFT事务。
• [_trampeltier] 简单表示当前系统虽然有问题但仍然能工作，暗示对变革的需求不强烈。
• [mike_hearn] 详细分析了金融行业难以变革的原因，包括其去中心化特性、缺乏主导实体来推动标准化、以及企业和技术部门之间的不信任。他还提到区块链曾被视为解决方案，但实际效果不如预期。

补充讨论：
• [Fizzadar] 提供了一个2014年的系列文章链接，讨论了金融系统的缓慢和脆弱性，并指出没有升级到实时系统。
• [UltraSane] 提到曾在一家公司工作，需要验证从大银行通过FTP发送的用PGP密钥签名的文件，显示出在安全措施上的一些实践。

争议焦点：
• 当前金融和技术行业使用的传统传输方式（如FTP）是否需要变革以及如何有效地进行变革。
• 金融行业在技术标准化和现代化方面的挑战，包括去中心化结构带来的复杂性以及对区块链技术的不成功尝试。

整体来看，讨论反映了金融和技术行业在数据传输和协作方面的现实问题，以及变革过程中面临的多重障碍和考虑。

data.title: Cows get GPS collars to stop them falling in river
data.author: zeristor
data.article_summary: 剑桥市议会为防止牛只在放牧季节落入剑河，给牛佩戴了GPS项圈。这些太阳能项圈在牛接近河边时会发出高音并给予轻微电击，以阻止其继续前进。此前，每年有多达四头牛在放牧季节落入河中，市议会需花费约1万英镑打捞。新技术的使用旨在减少这一开支。同时，市议会承诺继续资助放牧传统，并强调此举对市民和游客的特殊意义。动物救援队仍会在牛遇到困难时进行救助。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：虚拟围栏技术及其在放牧和动物管理中的应用

不同观点：
• **支持虚拟围栏技术的实用性**：
   - **gorgoiler**：认为虚拟围栏技术不仅可以解决牧草轮作问题，还能监控牛的健康和繁殖状态，甚至可能发展出双向通讯功能，方便远距离处理突发情况。
   - **scowby**：引用澳大利亚的研究，指出虚拟围栏可以避免在河流等区域设置实体围栏，同时节省大量围栏费用。
   - **sharklasers123**：提到HalterHQ的虚拟围栏技术，可以利用噪音和振动引导牛群，甚至可以让牛群自动走回棚里挤奶。

• **对技术应用的质疑和成本考虑**：
   - **krisoft**：指出虚拟围栏技术可能减少但不能完全消除对外勤服务的需要，导致同时需要支付技术费用和服务费用，增加成本。
   - **MarkusWandel**：质疑高科技解决方案的必要性，认为低科技的实体围栏也曾是有效的解决方案。

• **实例和个人经验**：
   - **parkersweb**：以个人观察为例，提到当地由于公共用地和河流的特殊地理条件，实体围栏并不总是可行，期待看到虚拟围栏的实际效果。
   - **gadders**：分享了一次实际救援事件，牛被困在河边的泥泞中，最终需要专业救援单位帮助，显示出虚拟围栏技术的潜在应用场景。

• **文化与技术背景的讨论**：
   - **chaps**：指出GPS技术自20世纪80年代以来已用于牛群追踪，并提到有些公司已将类似技术用于人类的行为监控，质疑GPS的精确性。
   - **ViscountPenguin**：提到当地曾使用类似技术放牧，并认为这些设备很可爱，带有一定的情感色彩。

• **政治与技术政策的讨论**：
   - **aa-jv**：赞赏剑桥的绿色空间和文化氛围，提到在享受自然环境时偶尔会被牛打扰，但这也是城市特色之一。
   - **mschuster91**：引述德国政治中的讨论，指出在德国农村地区5G技术的推广存在争议，并提到在阿尔卑斯山地区使用临时电围栏的传统做法。

补充讨论：
• **幽默和文化参考**：
   - **emmelaich**：提到一本经典儿童书籍《The Cow Who Fell in the Canal》，为讨论增添了幽默元素。
   - **amelius**：以幽默方式建议通过在河床上放生乌龟解决问题，引用了一个YouTube视频。

争议焦点：
• 虚拟围栏技术的实际成本效益和必要性是讨论的主要争议点。一方认为技术带来诸多便利，另一方则质疑其成本和是否比传统方法更有效。

44079729.article_content:
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
Cattle graze on commons including Midsummer Common in the centre of Cambridge
Published
20 May 2025
Cows have been fitted with GPS collars to try to stop them falling into a river.
Cambridge City Council said up to four ended up in the River Cam during grazing season between April and October each year.
Solar-powered GPS devices emit a high-pitched sound as the animal moves through a boundary zone towards the water, with a mild electric pulse delivered if it fails to turn around.
The council spends about Â£10,000 a year funding a team to recover cattle from the river, and said the new technology would help with costs.
Image source,
PA Media
Cows can be seen roaming on council-owned green spaces such as Midsummer and Stourbridge commons, Coe Fen, Lammas Land and Sheep's Green.
A team of animal rescuers employed by the council, known as pinders, are deployed if an animal gets into difficulty, such as getting stuck in the River Cam.
Last year, Cambridge City Council carried out a consultation on whether to pass the cost of the out-of-hours animal rescue service on to graziers.
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
The tradition of grazing cattle on common land goes back to the Middle Ages
However, the authority has given reassurance - after public support for cows grazing on the commons - that it will "continue to fund grazing" and has "improved animal welfare with a technology that keeps the cows from falling into the river".
Martin Smart, executive councillor for open space and city services, said: "The council recognises the symbolic importance of the cows grazing on the commons.
"This is a special and unique feature of the city that is much loved by residents and visitors alike."

主要讨论点：关于主流媒体（MSM）对Doom相关内容的点击诱饵式报道的讨论

不同观点：
• branon认为主流媒体记者正在利用Doom相关内容制作点击诱饵，并调侃说需要找新的爱好来替代。
• unwind提出一个具体的建议，认为如果在标题中以"Doom:"开头，可能会减少点击诱饵的感觉。
• tromp提供了一个存档链接，可能意图为讨论提供存档证据或引导读者查看相关内容。

data.title: BGP handling bug causes widespread internet routing instability
data.author: robin_reala
data.article_summary: 2025年5月20日，一个包含损坏的BGP Prefix-SID属性的BGP更新消息引发了互联网路由不稳定。该消息本不应出现在互联网表的BGP更新中，但由于一些主要BGP实现（如JunOS和Arista EOS）的交互问题，导致许多网络出现短暂连接中断。具体来说，JunOS传递了 corrupt 消息，而Arista EOS设备在接收后重置了会话。多个AS参与了此事件，其中AS9304（Hutchison）和AS135338（Starcloud）最有可能是添加该属性的源头。由于Hutchison在许多互联网交换中心的存在，消息通过路由服务器传播到更多网络，进一步扩大了影响。约100个网络受到影响，包括SpaceX Starlink、Zscaler和Bytedance等。此事暴露了BGP错误处理中的严重缺陷，强调了厂商需要改进错误处理机制。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：BGP协议处理问题及其相关挑战

不同观点：
• **对处理错误消息的策略**：
  - **ta1243**：提出四种处理损坏消息的策略，认为关闭连接（选项2，Arista的做法）虽然不理想但可以接受，而选项4（完全崩溃）是不可接受的。
  - **补充**：ta1243后来修正了自己的观点，指出Arista实际上执行的是选项2而不是4。

• **标准化问题和厂商锁定**：
  - **Perenti**：认为BGP的稳定性问题部分源于各硬件厂商缺乏统一的处理标准，推测厂商因为想要锁定客户而不愿意标准化。
  - **补充**：Perenti声明自己对BGP的理解不深。

• **BGP复杂性和长期问题**：
  - **sc68cal**：提到修复CVE-2023-4481的紧急性，并指出由于BGP的设计和实现方式，这类问题需要很长时间才能解决。
  - **mintflow**：认为BGP过于复杂，且由于不断添加新功能，这类bug会不断出现。

• **各厂商的历史漏洞**：
  - **CSN3RD**：列举了过去多个厂商的BGP漏洞，指出Arista当时未受影响。

• **学习和测试BGP的困难**：
  - **dakiol**：提到BGP的重要性，但在学习和实践中的缺失，不知如何在家进行BGP实验。
  - **jiveturkey**：建议成立一个联盟来开发互操作性测试套件，并使用fuzzer生成测试案例以发现潜在问题。
  - **incomingpain**：质疑BGP协议是否经过充分fuzz测试，并指出诊断崩溃的困难。

补充讨论：
• **其他讨论**：
  - **bhaney**：纠正了一个日期错误。
  - **mschuster91**：讨论了学术作弊问题，认为解决学位和就业之间的关联可以减少作弊。
  - **mgaunard**：提问BGP是否支持互联网上的多播。

争议焦点：
• 各厂商对BGP错误处理的不一致性和缺乏标准化是讨论的核心争议点，特别是这些处理方式对网络稳定性和用户体验的影响。

May 27 2025
BGP handling bug causes widespread internet routing instability
At 7AM (UTC) on Wednesday May 20th 2025 a BGP message was propagated that triggered surprising (to many) behaviours with two major BGP implementations that are often used for carrying internet traffic.
This caused a large number of “internet facing” BGP sessions to automatically shut down, causing at the very least some routing instability, and at worst brief loss of connectivity for some networks.
What was the message?
Using the sessions that people feed to bgp.tools, we can see here a version of the update that caused this behavior, it is a relatively unremarkable BGP Update for a /16, except it had a BGP Prefix-SID Attribute that was not only unwelcome (it is unexpected to see this on internet table BGP updates), but it was also corrupt with all of its internal data being 0x00.
Most implementations (IOS-XR/Nokia SR-OS) correctly filtered this out without causing any problems assuming their systems have been setup for
RFC7606
(“BGP error tolerance”), however an interesting interaction with JunOS and Arista EOS caused JunOS to carry the corrupt message, and Arista EOS devices to reset sessions when receiving the message from (likely) a JunOS device.
Since a lot of internet transit carriers use Juniper hardware running JunOS, this meant that those running Arista EOS and connected to an upstream transit carrier router running JunOS would have had their access to the internet severed for a period (likely up to 10 mins).
Who emitted the message?
After filtering through the whole bgp.tools archive for that period, it would appear that a number of AS origins were involved with this incident. Suggesting that rather than the attribute having been added by the network that originated the prefix, it was added by a carrier in the middle on its way to the wider internet.
The 4 candidates that appear in all of the offending messages are:
AS9304
( Hutchison Global Communications Limited )
AS135338
( Starcloud Information Limited )
AS151326
( DCConnect Communication Pte. Ltd. )
AS138077
( PT Abhinawa Sumberdaya Asia )
However, bgp.tools has captured routes for the impacted prefixes
without the faulty BGP attribute
from “[…] 151326 138077 […]“, meaning the culprit that added the attribute was likely Starcloud (AS135338) or Hutchison (AS9304).
Some prefixes seen in updates carrying the attribute (despite very likely not being the ones that added the offending attribute) are
156.230.0.0/16
138.113.116.0/24
163.171.102.0/24
163.171.103.0/24
163.171.104.0/24
This incident was further amplified by Hutchison/AS9304 being on a large number of internet exchanges, meaning that the offending messages were sent to IX route servers that typically are running
bird
. Since Bird does not support BGP SID, the message was distributed to many multi-terabit internet exchanges without being filtered, spreading the chaos to more than just internet transit sessions.
What is BGP Prefix-SID?
BGP Prefix-SID Attribute should generally only be seen in internal BGP sessions, as the point of them (as defined in
RFC8669
) is to help define the route the traffic will take within a single network to get to the destination.
The reason that one of these attributes leaked out into the global routing table in the first place could have been caused by an external BGP session being configured as an internal one.
Who was impacted?
While it is hard to definitively claim who was impacted, after looking at networks with very large churn (compared to their size) immediately after the initial problematic BGP message was emitted, I count around 100 separate networks that hit issues, some high confidence examples include:
SpaceX Starlink
AS14593
Zscaler
AS62044
/
AS53813
Bytedance
AS396986
Disney Worldwide Services
AS23344
Nagasaki Cable Media Inc
AS10000
Global Secure Layer
AS7578
UpCloud
AS202053
Netskope
AS55256
Teleguam Holdings
AS9246
In “normal” times the bgp.tools’s route collector ingests around 20,000 to 30,000 messages per second, during this incident the average 10 second message rate was well over 150,000 /s. Indicating significant disruption to many internet paths.
Vendors need to get their act together
While the root cause (or even perpetrator) is not entirely clear, the fact that it propagated over the internet at scale is a demonstration of the situation/risk that I described in my previous post
“Grave flaws in BGP Error handling” - August 2023
.
In this case while other vendors detected the faulty attribute and suppressed the announcement, Juniper allowed it to propagate to peers, until it ultimately hit Arista devices that did not (or contained faulty) have BGP error tolerance code.
Junipers
own documentation for JunOS’s BGP error tolerance
points out that it does not look at all parts of the message, despite it potentially being able to understand that it is faulty.
This is a curious decision, in which JunOS will save itself fr

data.article_summary: 文章介绍了田纳西大学研究助理教授Vladimir Dinets博士的观察，他发现了一只库珀鹰利用交通信号成功狩猎的现象。这只鹰会在交通灯变红、车辆排队较长时，利用汽车作掩护，攻击在一户人家前觅食的小鸟群。Dinets注意到，当行人按下按钮使红灯时间延长时，鹰会等待汽车排成长队，然后低飞利用车辆作掩护，突袭猎物。这表明库珀鹰能够理解和利用人类制造的交通系统来提高狩猎成功率，展示了动物在城市环境中的适应能力。

Science News
Featured news
Street smarts: how a hawk learned to use traffic signals to hunt more successfully
Street smarts: how a hawk learned to use traffic signals to hunt more successfully
Adult Cooper’s hawk dispatching a house sparrow. Image: Vladimir Dinets.
Dr Vladimir Dinets, a research assistant professor at the University of Tennessee, is a zoologist who studies animal behavior, ecology, and conservation. As of 2025, he also teaches mathematics at Rudgers University. He is the author of a recently published
Frontiers in Ethology
article
that documents the impressive adaptation of an avian newcomer to the city. A Cooper’s hawk, a medium-sized raptor native to North America, appears to have learned how to adapt its hunting strategy and strike at a flock of birds precisely when cars at an intersection lined up after traffic lights switched to red, having been alerted by a sound signal that the red phase would last longer than usual. In the following guest editorial, he describes his observations.
by
Dr Vladimir Dinets
Many years ago, I got to spend some time in Ngorongoro Crater, a unique place in Africa where immense herds of animals are being watched by equally immense crowds of 4x4-riding tourists, and traffic jams of all kinds are frequent. On my last evening there, a local guide told me at a campfire that some buffalo in the crater had figured out the meaning of car turn signals and used that understanding to get out of the way of turning Jeeps and Land Rovers.
I never had a chance to return to the crater and still don’t know if that story was true, but it got me interested in animals’ perception of – and interactions with – human-made vehicles. Of course, the most common interaction is the animal becoming a roadkill, but it’s not the whole story. Many animals have learned to use cars for their own benefit, and birds seem to be particularly good at it. Crows drop walnuts, clams, even small vertebrates onto busy roads to have them killed and/or crushed by cars. Carrion-eating birds routinely monitor or patrol busy roads to immediately snatch roadkill. For example, many American highways are partitioned by families of ravens who watch them from dawn till dusk, waiting for meals from under wheels. Songbirds glean dead insects from cars and even nest in moving cars, trains and boats. Small birds use moving cars as mobile shelters from pursuing hawks, while hawks in one Ukrainian city have long been known to use moving cars and streetcars as cover to sneak up on their prey.
Hunt at the crosswalk
So I’ve been keeping an eye for unusual bird-car play, and that’s why I noticed something interesting going on at a street intersection near my home. The intersection wasn’t particularly busy, and even during morning rush hour, when I was driving my daughter to school, there were usually only a few cars waiting for the green light. But sometimes a pedestrian pressed a button, and that caused the red light to last a lot longer, so the car queue became longer, too, stretching all the way to a small streetside tree with a particularly dense crown. When that happened, the streetlight produced a sound signal, letting blind people know that it was safe to cross.
The study area. The route used by the hawk to attack a flock of birds feeding in front of house #2 is shown with white arrows. The hawk appeared in the tree in front of house #11 as soon as sound signals at the streetlight at the intersection (marked with white asterisks) indicated that red light will be longer than usual, and attacked when the queue of cars reached house #8, making it possible for the hawk to move to the tree in front of house #1 without being visible to potential prey. Credit: Dinets, 2025.
One winter morning I was in my car waiting for the light to change and suddenly saw a Cooper’s hawk: it emerged from that small tree, flew very low above the sidewalk along the line of cars, made a sharp turn, crossed the street between the cars, and dove onto something near one of the houses.
A few days later I saw the same thing happen again and decided to investigate. It turned out that the house targeted by the hawk’s attacks was inhabited by a nice big family that liked to eat dinner in the front yard. Next morning their breadcrumbs and other leftovers attracted a small flock of birds – sparrows, doves, and sometimes starlings. That’s what the hawk was after.
But what was really interesting, and took me much longer to figure out, was that the hawk always attacked when the car queue was long enough to provide cover all the way to the small tree, and that only happened after someone had pressed the pedestrian crossing button. As soon as the sound signal was activated, the raptor would fly from somewhere into the small tree, wait for the cars to line up, and then strike.

data.title: LumoSQL
data.author: smartmic
data.article_summary: LumoSQL是一个对SQLite嵌入式数据库库的修改项目（非分支），旨在增强SQLite的安全性、隐私性、性能和测量功能。它支持可插拔后端，包括默认的SQLite Btree、LMDB和Berkley Database，并计划添加更多新的键值存储。LumoSQL引入了现代加密功能，如基于属性的加密（ABE），并支持逐行加密和校验，以快速检测错误。项目处于第二阶段，使用MIT许可，并得到NLNet基金会支持，运行于x86、ARM-32和RISC-V架构以及多种Linux和BSD系统。LumoSQL通过"Not-forking"工具跟踪上游变化，并结合使用LumoSQL构建和基准系统，以配置和增强SQLite。尽管存在一些限制和测试问题，LumoSQL展示了SQLite可能在未来多年无法实现的功能改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LumoSQL及其相关技术（如SQLite、LMDB等）的特性、优势、技术细节和应用场景

不同观点：
• Lio认为LumoSQL的"Not-Forking"理念是其最有趣的特性，并提供了相关文档链接以供参考。
• Diggan强调LumoSQL的主要目标是增强隐私、加密和可复现性，同时指出对项目阶段（如Phase 1和可能的Phase 3）的不确定性。
• Lord_Zero批评LumoSQL的主页没有清楚说明其具体功能和用途。
• Mmooss对SQLite团队与LumoSQL的合作情况以及其在生产环境中的表现提出疑问，特别是在需要与SQLite兼容的情况下。
• Alexpadula关注LumoSQL的锁定机制和多写入优化，并提到Wildcat作为一个无锁存储引擎的潜在应用。
• Maxloh提到SQLite的测试套件是专有的，质疑像LumoSQL这样的“分支”如何在更改后保持与上游的兼容性和功能性。
• Cluckindan建议使用BadgerDB作为键值后端。
• Blacklion提到LMDB的bug问题，并对LMDB替换SQLite后端的必要性提出质疑，同时提到一个有争议的开发者及其许可证变更。
• Noduerme对SQLite不再支持浏览器内使用表示遗憾，并质疑在现代开发中使用SQLite的优势，特别是与MySQL相比。
• Pmbanugo对LMDB的混合使用表示兴趣。
• Canadiantim比较了LumoSQL与LibSQL/Turso，并询问LumoSQL是否可以与Litestream一起用于复制。
• Herodoturtle对LumoSQL的每行校验和特性表示赞赏，并表达了良好祝愿。

补充讨论：
• 关于"Not-Forking"理念的讨论，关注LumoSQL在不真正分叉SQLite的情况下如何增加新功能。
• 关于SQLite兼容性和生产环境应用的讨论，特别是如何在保持兼容性的同时增强功能。
• 对不同数据库技术（如LMDB、BadgerDB）的优缺点进行比较，并讨论其适用场景。
• 对SQLite不再支持浏览器内使用的失望情绪，以及在现代开发中使用SQLite的实际优势和用例。
• 关于LumoSQL锁定机制和多写入优化的技术讨论，以及与其他技术（如Wildcat、Litestream）的潜在集成。

LumoSQL
LumoSQL
is a modification (
not a fork
) of the
SQLite
embedded data storage library, which is among the
most-deployed software
. We are currently in
Phase II of the project
.
If you are reading this on GitHub you are looking at a read-only mirror.
The master is always available at
lumosql.org
.
LumoSQL adds security, privacy, performance and measurement features to SQLite.
Benchmarking
SQLite can test and compare results consistently across many kinds of system and configurations using the
Not-forking tool
. Example:
Pluggable backends
LumoSQL can swap back end key-value store engines in and out of SQLite. LMDB is
the most famous (but not the only) example of an alternative key-value store,
and LumoSQL can combine dozes of versions of LMDB and SQLite source code like
this:
In LumoSQL 0.4 there are three LumoSQL backends:
the default SQLite Btree storage system
LMDB
the ancient Berkley Database
We are looking at some interesting new development in key-value storage to add and benchmark.
Encryption and corruption detection, optionally per-row
LumoSQL adds modern encryption to SQLite, including
Attribute-Based Encryption
(ABE)
. This can be
done on a per-row basis, and also includes per-row checksums so that any error
can be noticed quickly and located down to the individual row. Per-row
checksums also make some search and comparison operations much faster.
Organised and Supported
LumoSQL is distributed under
very liberal MIT licence terms
.
LumoSQL is supported by the
NLNet Foundation
.
LumoSQL runs on x86, ARM-32 and RISC-V architectures, and many Linux and BSD OSs.
Table of Contents
Design, Not-Forking and Participating
LumoSQL, and SQLite's Billions of Users
Limitations of LumoSQL
Build Environment and Dependencies
Using the Build and Benchmark System
A Brief History of LumoSQL
Design, Not-Forking and Participating
If you are reading this on Github, then you are looking at a mirror. LumoSQL is
is maintained using
the Fossil repository
. If you
want to participate in LumoSQL there is a forum, and if you have code contributions
you can ask for access to the respository.
LumoSQL has multiple upstreams, but does not fork any of them despite needing modifications.
The novel
Not-forking
tool semi-automatically
tracks upstream changes and is a requirement for building LumoSQL. Between not-forking
and the
LumoSQL Build and Benchmark System
,
LumoSQL is as much about combining and configuring upstreams as it is about creating
original database software. By maintaining Not-forking outside LumoSQL, we hope
other projects will find it useful.
The LumoSQL and SQLite projects are cooperating, so any merge friction is
expected to become less over time, and key to that is the approach of not
forking.
LumoSQL, and SQLite's Billions of Users
LumoSQL exists to demonstrate changes to SQLite that might be useful, but which
SQLite probably cannot consider for many years because of SQLite's unique
position of being used by a majority of the world's population.
SQLite is used by thousands of software projects, just three being
Google's Android, Mozilla's Firefox and Apple's iOS which between them have
billions of users. That is a main reason why SQLite is so careful and conservative
with all changes.
On the other hand, many of these same users need SQLite to have new features
which do not fit with the SQLite project's cautious approach, and LumoSQL is a
demonstration of some of these improvements.
The LumoSQL documentation project reviews dozens of relevant codebases.  SQLite
has become ubiquitous over two decades, which means there is a great deal of
preparation needed when considering architectural changes.
Limitations of LumoSQL
As of LumoSQL 0.4, there are many obvious limitations, including:
The tests used in benchmarking mostly come from an ancient version of SQLite's
speedtest.tcl modified many times, to which DATASIZE
and DEBUG have been added. Experts in SQLite and LMDB database testing
should review the files in not-fork.d/sqlite3/benchmark/*test. There are
9 tools named *speed*
in the SQLite source, and any/all of them should be added here.
Neither LMDB nor BDB backends ship with latest SQLite builds. Now all the LumoSQL infrastructure
exists, that is a smaller, more maintainable and repeatable task. But it is not done yet.
There are some generic problems to be solved in the process, such as the optimal way to
address keysize disparities between a KVP store provider and SQLite's internal large keysize.
If we import more of the speed tests from SQLite identified above, then we will
have a problem with several LMDB and at least two BDB instances, where the SQLite
tests will fail. In most cases this is about the LMDB port needing to be more
complete but in some it is about relevance, where some SQLite tests will not apply. In
addition some backends will always need
to have additional tests (for example, BDB has more extensive u

data.title: Worlds first petahertz transistor at ambient conditions
data.author: ChuckMcM
data.article_summary: 美国亚利桑那大学的研究团队正在开发世界上首个在常温常压下运行的太赫兹（petahertz）速度光电晶体管。由物理学和光学副教授Mohammed Hassan领导的研究小组利用石墨烯中的量子隧穿效应，通过持续不到一万亿分之一秒的光脉冲操控电子，实现了超越现有计算机处理器百万倍的速度。该技术利用了对称石墨烯结构中的特殊电流现象，使得电子能近乎瞬时穿过屏障。该研究发表在《Nature Communications》上，展示了在量子计算和超高速数据处理领域的巨大潜力，有望 revolutionize 计算机硬件发展，并应用于人工智能、太空研究、化学和医疗等领域。团队正与Tech Launch Arizona合作，推动该发明商业化。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对研究声称的"~1.6 petahertz 速度"的评论和分析

不同观点：
• [kragen] 指出，虽然论文声称"~1.6 petahertz 速度"，但实际上只是过渡时间为630 阿秒，并非整个周期都在飞秒以内。他担心设备寿命问题，因为使用了紫外光，并且认为标题可能导致误解。
• [ChuckMcM] 认为这是一个伟大的研究，特别提到使用了商业石墨烯晶体管，并且设备不需要极端条件（如超低温或高压）。他还幽默地提到这可能对比特币挖掘产生影响。
• [ziofill] 从物理角度指出，在630阿秒内光只能走半微米，这意味着芯片内信号同步会非常复杂。
• [mjrpes] 强调1 petahertz 芯片比5 gigahertz 芯片快200,000倍，直接跳过太赫兹范围，感到震惊。
• [bjourne] 提出疑问，是否意味着用光子代替电子，并质疑如何实现纳米或皮米级别的光路。
• [GuB-42] 对petahertz 的概念提出根本性质疑，认为这超出了传统晶体管的理解范围，涉及到量子现象，并质疑实际应用。
• [amelius] 认为目标设定过高，对未来几年内实现太赫兹CPU感到满意。
• [booli] 对研究的重要性感到不确定，怀疑是否遗漏了基本信息。
• [actinium226] 幽默地期待能在petahertz速度下观看猫视频。
• [AnimalMuppet] 担心在如此高的时钟频率下，信号传播延迟会成为严重问题。
• [stretchwithme] 认为摩尔定律尚未终结，暗示技术仍有发展空间。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于论文中声称的petahertz速度是否真实反映了实际应用中的周期时间，以及设备在这种极端频率下的寿命和物理实现问题。
• 讨论中涉及了设备实现的具体技术问题，如光路设计、信号同步和传播延迟等。
• 不同评论者对技术实现的乐观程度不一，有人感到兴奋，有人则持怀疑态度。
• 幽默评论和夸张预期（如对比特币挖掘和观看猫视频的影响）也为讨论增添了一些轻松的色彩。

44083474.article_content:
U of A researchers developing world's first petahertz-speed phototransistor in ambient conditions
By Logan Burtch-Buus, University Communications
May 19, 2025
Image
Mohammed Hassan (right), associate professor of physics and optical sciences, and Mohamed Sennary, a graduate student studying optics and physics, holding the commercial transistor they used to develop a petahertz-speed transistor.
What if ultrafast pulses of light could operate computers at speeds a million times faster than today's best processors? A team of scientists, including researchers from the University of Arizona, are working to make that possible.
In a groundbreaking international effort, researchers from the
Department of Physics
in the
College of Science
and the
James C. Wyant College of Optical Sciences
demonstrated a way to manipulate electrons in graphene using pulses of light that last less than a trillionth of a second. By leveraging a quantum effect known as tunneling, they recorded electrons bypassing a physical barrier almost instantaneously, a feat that redefines the potential limits of computer processing power.
A study published in
Nature Communications
highlights how the technique could lead to processing speeds in the petahertz range – over 1,000 times faster than modern computer chips.
Sending data at those speeds would revolutionize computing as we know it, said Mohammed Hassan, an associate professor of
physics
and
optical sciences
. Hassan
has long pursued
light-based computer technology and previously led efforts
to develop
the world's fastest electron microscope.
"We have experienced a huge leap forward in the development of technologies like artificial intelligence software, but the speed of hardware development does not move as quickly," Hassan said. "But, by leaning on the discovery of quantum computers, we can develop hardware that matches the current revolution in information technology software. Ultrafast computers will greatly assist discoveries in space research, chemistry, health care and more."
Hassan worked alongside U of A colleagues Nikolay Golubev, an assistant professor of physics; Mohamed Sennary, a graduate student studying optics and physics; Jalil Shah, a postdoctoral scholar of physics; and Mingrui Yuan, an optics graduate student. They were joined by colleagues from the California Institute of Technology's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich in Germany.
The team was originally studying the electrical conductivity of modified samples of graphene, a material composed of a single layer of carbon atoms. When a laser shines on graphene, the energy of the laser excites electrons in the material, making them move and form into a current.
Sometimes, those electric currents cancel each other out. Hassan said this happens because the laser's energy wave moves up and down, generating equal and opposite currents on either side of the graphene. Because of graphene's symmetrical atomic structure, these currents mirror each other and cancel each other out, leaving no detectable current.
But what if a single electron could slip through the graphene, and its journey could be captured and tracked in real time? That near-instant "tunnelling" was the unexpected result of the team modifying different graphene samples.
"That is what I love most about science: The real discovery comes from the things you don't expect to happen," Hassan said. "Going into the lab, you always anticipate what will happen – but the real beauty of science are the little things that happen, which lead you to investigate more. Once we realized that we had achieved this tunneling effect, we had to find out more."
Using a commercially available graphene phototransistor that was modified to introduce a special silicon layer, the researchers used a laser that switches off and on at a rate of 638 attoseconds to create what Hassan called "the world's fastest petahertz quantum transistor."
A transistor is a device that acts as an electronic switch or amplifier that controls the flow of electricity between two points and is fundamental to the development of modern electronics.
"For reference, a single attosecond is one-quintillionth of a second," Hassan said. "That means that this achievement represents a big leap forward in the development of ultrafast computer technologies by realizing a petahertz-speed transistor."
While some scientific advancements occur under strict conditions, including temperature and pressure, this new transistor performed in ambient conditions – opening the way to commercialization and use in everyday electronics.
Hassan is working with
Tech Launch Arizona
, the office that works with investigators to commercialize inventions stemming from U of A research in order to patent and market innovations. While the original invention used a specialized laser, the researchers are furthering development of a transistor compatible with commercially available equipment.

data.title: The Myth of Developer Obsolescence
data.author: cat-whisperer
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了技术进步如何影响软件开发领域，特别关注从无代码（NoCode）到人工智能辅助开发的演变。每次新技术出现时，都会有人宣称它将取代开发人员，但实际情况往往是转变而非取代。无代码运动没有消除开发者，而是催生了新的专业角色，如无代码专家和后端整合者，且薪资更高。同样，云计算没有取代系统管理员，而是将他们转变为薪资更高的DevOps工程师。

目前，人工智能辅助开发正经历类似过程。尽管AI能生成代码，但高级工程师仍需花费大量时间验证和修正其输出。软件开发中最有价值的技能并非写代码，而是系统架构设计，这是AI无法替代的核心能力。

总之，技术革新往往提升而非消除专业技能，开发人员需不断适应并学习新技能以应对变化。

44105592.article_content:
From NoCode to AI-Assisted
Every few years, a shiny new technology emerges that promises to make software developers obsolete. The headlines follow a predictable pattern: "The End of Coding," "Anyone Can Build Apps Now," or my personal favorite, "Why Your Five-Year-Old Will Be Programming Before Learning to Read."
The executives get excited. The consultants circle like sharks. PowerPoint decks multiply. Budgets shift.
And then reality sets in.
What actually happens isn't replacement, it's transformation. Technologies that promised to eliminate the need for technical expertise end up creating entirely new specializations, often at higher salary points than before. The NoCode movement didn't eliminate developers; it created NoCode specialists and backend integrators. The cloud didn't eliminate system administrators; it transformed them into DevOps engineers at double the salary.
Now we're witnessing the same pattern with AI-assisted development. The promise that "AI will write all your code" is evolving into the reality that we need engineers who can effectively orchestrate AI systems, which is essentially the same engineers, but now with new skills and higher salary expectations.
But there's something deeper happening with this particular transformation. Unlike previous technological shifts that primarily changed how we implement solutions, AI-assisted development is highlighting a fundamental truth about software engineering that has always existed but is now impossible to ignore:
The most valuable skill in software isn't writing code, it's architecting systems.
And as we'll see, that's the one skill AI isn't close to replacing.
The Endless Carousel of Replacement Promises
How many times have we ridden this merry-go-round? Let's count the rotations:
The NoCode/LowCode Revolution
Remember when drag-and-drop interfaces were going to let business users build their own applications? The promise was clear: "Why hire expensive developers when anyone can build an app?"
What actually happened: These tools created a new class of problems. Someone still needed to design the data models underpinning those shiny interfaces, integrate with existing systems and databases, handle edge cases the visual tools couldn't address, and maintain and upgrade as requirements evolved.
The result wasn't fewer developers—it was the birth of "NoCode specialists" who understood both the business domain and the technical limitations of these platforms. And guess what? They commanded higher salaries than the developers they supposedly replaced.
The Cloud Revolution
"Move to the cloud and you won't need system administrators anymore!"
As if infrastructure would somehow manage itself once it was someone else's server. The cloud didn't eliminate the need for systems expertise. Instead, it transformed what that expertise looked like and dramatically expanded its scope.
The sysadmins weren't eliminated; they were reborn as DevOps engineers with fancy new job titles and substantially higher compensation packages. The work didn't disappear; it evolved into infrastructure-as-code, automated deployment pipelines, and distributed systems management.
As I noted in my
LinkedIn post about microservices
: "I've watched teams spend months decomposing perfectly functional systems into microservices only to discover they've traded one set of problems for a more expensive set." The cloud enabled this complexity and someone still needed to manage it. That someone was still a systems expert, just operating at a higher level of abstraction.
The Offshore Development Wave
"Why pay local developers when you can get the same work done for a fraction of the cost overseas?"
The promise of dramatic cost savings quickly collided with the reality of communication challenges, quality issues, and the discovery that effective software development requires deep contextual knowledge and continuous collaboration.
What emerged instead was a more nuanced approach: distributed teams with clear ownership boundaries, stronger architecture practices, and—surprise—higher total costs than initially projected.
The AI Coding Assistant Revolution
And now we have AI promising to write our code for us. "Just describe what you want, and the AI will generate it!"
The early reality is already emerging. AI generates plausible-looking code that often contains subtle inconsistencies and errors. Senior engineers spend significant time verifying and correcting AI output. The "vibe coding" phenomenon means experienced developers extract far more value than novices. Systems built entirely with AI assistance often lack coherent architecture.
"In the world of the chisel, you just gave carpenters a CNC machine. Guess who will make the better furniture?"
The pattern is becoming clear once again: the technology doesn't replace the skill, it elevates it to a higher level of abstraction.
Why This Time Is Different
Here's what the "AI will replace developers" crowd fundamentally misunderstands:

data.title: OpenPOWER Foundation – Open-Source / Open Hardware PowerPC CPU ISA
data.author: peter_d_sherman
data.article_summary:
《开放创新》  
开放动力基金会（OpenPOWER Foundation）促进技术合作，汇集超过350名成员，通过完全开放的生态系统加速创新。其核心是基于POWER指令集架构（ISA），该架构是先进的处理器架构之一，使RISC架构得以广泛应用。基金会结合20年的软硬件经验，推动半导体行业的弹性发展，支持从人工智能到超级计算等多个领域的数百项创新，实现硬件和软件堆栈的全面定制和选择自由。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Power ISA与RISC-V的比较及其优劣势

不同观点：
• **jamesy0ung的观点**：对Power ISA的存在价值提出疑问，认为RISC-V可能是一个更有吸引力的选择，但没有详细说明具体原因。其核心问题是Power ISA相对于RISC-V的卖点是什么。

• **ladyanita22的观点**：质疑为什么大家更关注RISC-V，而Power架构已经拥有高性能的内核。她提出了一个真诚的疑问，表明对Power架构的性能有信心，并暗示可能不需要转向RISC-V。

• **ThinkBeat的观点**：引用Raptor的信息，指出最新的Power芯片包含一个大的二进制专有blob，并质疑这些专有部分是否会对OpenPOWER基金会造成问题。这暗示了对Power ISA开放性的担忧。

• **peter_d_sherman的观点**：通过引用相关资料和链接，强调Power ISA是高度复杂的处理器架构之一，并指出OpenPOWER基金会的目标是通过开放Power ISA来促进行业协作和创新。他强调Power ISA的开放性和协作潜力，并提到有超过350个成员参与，表明该平台的广泛支持和应用。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：Power ISA与RISC-V之间的选择问题，以及Power架构中专有blob是否影响其开放性。jamesy0ung和ladyanita22的讨论涉及两者之间的性能和吸引力比较，而ThinkBeat则关注Power ISA的开放性问题。

• **重要论据**：
  - Power架构已经拥有高性能内核（ladyanita22）。
  - Power芯片包含专有blob，可能影响其开放性（ThinkBeat）。
  - Power ISA的复杂性和开放性使其成为有吸引力的选择，并且有广泛的行业支持（peter_d_sherman）。

• **相关资料**：peter_d_sherman提供了维基百科和IT Jungle的文章链接，为讨论提供了背景信息和进一步阅读的资源。

总结来看，讨论的核心在于Power ISA和RISC-V之间的选择以及Power架构的开放性问题。不同参与者对Power ISA的性能、开放性和行业支持持不同看法，并提出了相应的论据和例子。

Complete Equation
Open development of this scale enables unprecedented customization across applications, operating systems and firmware - driving hundreds of innovations across artificial intelligence, supercomputing, hyperscale and more.

• **ThinkBeat的观点**：引用Raptor的信息，指出最新的Power芯片包含一个大的二进制专有blob，并质疑这些专有部分是否会对OpenPOWER基金会造成问题。这暗示了对Power ISA开放性的担忧。

• **peter_d_sherman的观点**：通过引用相关资料和链接，强调Power ISA是高度复杂的处理器架构之一，并指出OpenPOWER基金会的目标是通过开放Power ISA来促进行业协作和创新。他强调Power ISA的开放性和协作潜力，并提到有超过350个成员参与，表明该平台的广泛支持和应用。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：Power ISA与RISC-V之间的选择问题，以及Power架构中专有blob是否影响其开放性。jamesy0ung和ladyanita22的讨论涉及两者之间的性能和吸引力比较，而ThinkBeat则关注Power ISA的开放性问题。

• **重要论据**：
  - Power架构已经拥有高性能内核（ladyanita22）。
  - Power芯片包含专有blob，可能影响其开放性（ThinkBeat）。
  - Power ISA的复杂性和开放性使其成为有吸引力的选择，并且有广泛的行业支持（peter_d_sherman）。

• **相关资料**：peter_d_sherman提供了维基百科和IT Jungle的文章链接，为讨论提供了背景信息和进一步阅读的资源。

总结来看，讨论的核心在于Power ISA和RISC-V之间的选择以及Power架构的开放性问题。不同参与者对Power ISA的性能、开放性和行业支持持不同看法，并提出了相应的论据和例子。

**《教会法典》一般规范要点：**
1. 法典仅适用于拉丁教会，不决定礼仪细节，现有礼仪法仍有效。
2. 法典不废除宗座与国家或民事实体达成的协议，这些协议继续有效。
3. 已获得的权利和未撤销的特权保持不变，除非法典明确废除。
4. 与法典冲突且被法典谴责的习俗被完全废除，但百年或古老习俗可在特定情况下被容忍。
5. 法典生效后，1917年法典及与其冲突的法律将被废除，但特定法律另有规定除外。
6. 法律自颁布起生效，普遍教会法律通常在颁布后三个月生效。
7. 法律仅适用于未来事务，除非另有规定。
8. 仅明确规定无效或 incapacitating 的法律才具有此效力。
9. 教会法律对在天主教会受洗并具有足够理性者有约束力，通常自七岁起。
10. 普遍法律对所有相关人员具有约束力，但在特定地区可豁免。

该网站和法典为研究和应用教会法提供了详细资源和规范。

data.title: LiveStore: State management based on reactive SQLite and built-in sync engine
data.author: akoenig
data.article_summary: LiveStore是一个基于反应式SQLite和事件溯源的下一代状态管理框架，支持实时同步和跨平台使用。它通过提交事件来更新数据库并同步到其他客户端，具有嵌入式SQLite数据库，并支持与多种UI框架（如React、Solid等）集成。开发者通过定义事件和物质化器（materializers）来映射事件与数据库状态的变化，实现响应式查询和状态管理。LiveStore旨在替代Redux、MobX等库，提供更高效的客户端数据层解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LiveStore的发布及其架构设计、功能、应用场景和潜在问题

不同观点：
• cryptonector支持事件溯源架构，但指出在数据增长时，物化视图可能变慢，需要开发者编写触发器或使用CRDT进行冲突解决。他还建议一种类似SQLite且具备PostgreSQL功能的数据库以支持本地优先和远程优先配置。
• schickling（LiveStore的创建者）对LiveStore的发布感到兴奋，强调其结合了SQLite和事件溯源的同步机制，并邀请用户反馈。
• jessmartin在Local-first会议上了解了LiveStore，认为其在事件溯源与同步引擎结合方面探索了新的方向，并对其稳健性表示赞赏。
• parsadotsh祝贺发布，但质疑LiveStore是否适合某种序列化策略，并担心可能出现类似于ProseMirror协作中的锁定问题。
• pdyc关注数据离线持久化策略，询问具体使用的技术如OPFS或IndexedDB，并对不同浏览器中的不稳定实现表示担忧。
• maxjustus对演示视频中的音频问题提出了意见。
• brianzelip提到LocalFirst.fm播客对LiveStore的讨论。
• tionis询问LiveStore与instantdb在实际工作负载下的比较。
• growthwtf对跨平台支持表示质疑，指出Android web支持的缺失。
• akshayKMR对开发工具的提供表示赞赏，并提出关于长寿应用的压缩处理、事件溯源的代码维护以及Overtone的离线播放功能的问题。
• gbalduzzi对技术的潜力表示认可，但担心 hype trap，并询问是否可以添加E2E加密。
• eiiot表示LiveStore在Expo / RN中的表现优异，令人期待其未来的发展。
• bilater赞赏LiveStore的展示页面，认为其在竞争激烈的市场中脱颖而出。
• oliwary关注冲突解决的处理方式。
• rudi-c对LiveStore的技术表示赞赏，但认为其在不同用例（如Figma、Linear和Notion）的比较上可能引起混淆，并指出其在多人协作场景中的潜在问题和创新机会。

补充讨论：
• LiveStore在不同应用场景下的适用性，尤其是在文档为中心和多用户协作场景中的表现。
• 对数据模型设计、冲突处理以及离线支持的技术细节讨论。
• 对技术文档和市场定位的反馈，特别是在与其他知名工具比较时的清晰度问题。
• 用户对跨平台支持和特定功能（如Android web支持和离线播放）的需求和期望。

data.author: areoform
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了比尔·本特（Bill Benter）如何通过数学模型在香港赛马中赚取10亿美元的故事。1994年，本特发表了一篇学术论文，详细介绍了一个成功的赛马投注模型。尽管该模型已经过时，但论文仍提供了对数学在赛马投注中应用的独特见解。本文对该论文进行了注释版展示，使用香港赛马会的历史胜率数据，分析了模型的校准表，并尝试使用PyTorch重新调整模型。文章比较了1986-1993年以及后续三个十年的数据，强调了计算机化赛马投注系统的数据需求、模型开发、投注策略等关键要素。本特报告了该系统五年实际应用的显著正收益，证明了赛马投注中的市场 inefficiency。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：自动化赛马投注系统的有效性及其实际应用中的问题

不同观点：
• [AnotherGoodName] 认为当前的自动化赛马投注系统缺乏对赛马当天状态的视觉判断（如通过游行圈观察马匹状态），这种视觉信号（无论是通过机器视觉还是专家判断）可能显著提高系统的成功率。他们基于对马匹的实际经验，认为纯算法系统难以超越依赖视觉信号的系统。
• [bitshiftfaced] 引用了Edward Thorp的经历，提到尽管算法系统可以盈利，但实际操作中需要有人在现场下注，且携带大量现金存在风险。此外，这种策略的竞争力不如股票市场投资。
• [jeffreyrogers] 指出算法投注在赛马中已广泛应用，约占总投注额的40%。一些公司允许个人直接连接到投注池进行自动投注，且传闻最大的两个投注者每年下注超过10亿美元。
• [WalterBright] 认为赛马投注类似于与庄家对抗，而股票市场投资则是顺应经济增长的潮流，因此更倾向于后者。
• [PaulHoule] 分享了基于Dr. Z系统的个人经验，指出通过计算赢率和位置赔率之间的比率可以发现有利的投注机会，但这种方法的盈利有限且不能作为全职工作。
• [elpakal] 提到一个实际案例，表明经过多个赛季的改进，投注系统的回报率有显著上升趋势，且大多数赛季实现了净盈利。
• [tlyleung] 作为原作者，表示愿意回答任何问题，未提出新的观点但欢迎讨论。
• [gosub100] 强调即使发现了一个盈利的算法，也需要小心隐藏自己的投注行为，因为美国的赌场会禁止持续赢利的玩家，并可能拒绝支付奖金。
• [farceSpherule] 认为通过合理的投注策略可以盈利，但关键是要严格遵守策略，并在完成预定投注后离开，不继续用赢利下注。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于自动化系统是否能完全取代人类对赛马状态的视觉判断，[AnotherGoodName] 强调了视觉信号的重要性，而其他人如[jeffreyrogers]和[elpakal]则关注算法在实际应用中的表现和盈利能力。
- 另一个值得注意的讨论点是盈利投注者面临的实际问题，如赌场的限制措施([gosub100])以及严格遵守策略的必要性([farceSpherule])。
- 最后，部分讨论者如[WalterBright]和[PaulHoule]对赛马投注与股票市场投资进行了比较，认为后者可能更具竞争力和长期收益。

44105470.article_content:
The remarkable story of Bill Benter and how he amassed a staggering $1B fortune betting on horses in Hong Kong has been extensively documented in the article,
The Gambler Who Cracked the Horse-Racing Code
1
. In 1994, Benter published an academic paper titled
Computer Based Horse Race Handicapping and Wagering Systems: A Report
2
. In it, he documents the implementation of a successful horse race betting model, which by virtue of it being published, likely meant that the model was outdated and superceded by more sophisticated models. Despite this, the paper remains an insightful read, offering a rare glimpse into the lucrative application of mathematics to an unconventional field, made even more interesting by the substantial hardware and software limitations of the time.
In this post, we present an annotated version of the paper with added code blocks and blockquoted comments. The main text is all from the paper itself. Instead of building the fundamental and combined models, we’ll be highlighting interesting aspects of the paper using the public estimate, derived from the
Hong Kong Jockey Club’s historical win odds
. We’ll look at how the model calibration tables were generated in the original paper, assess how the public estimate has improved through the years and try our hand at fitting the adjustments factors from scratch using PyTorch. While the original paper uses data samples between 1986–1993, we’ll also be using data from the subsequent three decades (1996–2003, 2006–2013 and 2016–2023) for comparison.

Abstract
This paper examines the elements necessary for a practical and successful computerized horse race handicapping and wagering system. Data requirements, handicapping model development, wagering strategy, and feasibility are addressed. A logit-based technique and a corresponding heuristic measure of improvement are described for combining a fundamental handicapping model with the public’s implied probability estimates. The author reports significant positive results in five years of actual implementation of such a system. This result can be interpreted as evidence of inefficiency in pari-mutuel racetrack wagering. This paper aims to emphasize those aspects of computer handicapping which the author has found most important in practical application of such a system.
Introduction
The question of whether a fully mechanical system can ever “beat the races” has been widely discussed in both the academic and popular literature. Certain authors have convincingly demonstrated that profitable wagering systems do exist for the races. The most well documented of these have generally been of the
technical
variety, that is, they are concerned mainly with the public odds, and do not attempt to predict horse performance from fundamental factors. Technical systems for place and show betting, (Ziemba and Hausch, 1987) and exotic pool betting, (Ziemba and Hausch, 1986) as well as the “odds movement” system developed by Asch and Quandt (1986), fall into this category. A benefit of these systems is that they require relatively little preparatory effort, and can be effectively employed by the occasional racegoer. Their downside is that betting opportunities tend to occur infrequently and the maximum expected profit achievable is usually relatively modest. It is debatable whether any racetracks exist where these systems could be profitable enough to sustain a full-time professional effort.
To be truly viable, a system must provide a large number of high advantage betting opportunities in order that a sufficient amount of expected profit can be generated. An approach which does promise to provide a large number of betting opportunities is to
fundamentally
handicap each race, that is, to empirically assess each horse’s chance of winning, and utilize that assessment to find profitable wagering opportunities. A natural way to attempt to do this is to develop a computer model to estimate each horse’s probability of winning and calculate the appropriate amount to wager.

WinCse · Windows Cloud Storage Explorer
WinCse is an application that integrates object storage into Windows Explorer, allowing you to manage buckets as if they were local file systems.
Main Features
Operate object storage files just like Windows file sharing
Adjust the names and number of displayed buckets
Supports read-only mounting
Supports AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage
Compatible with S3-compatible object storage
System Requirements
Windows 11 or later recommended
WinFsp

AWS SDK for C++
Google Cloud Platform C++ Client Libraries

Install
WinFsp

release page

Run the appropriate script
with administrator privileges
, depending on the storage type:
AWS S3 →
setup/install-aws-s3.bat
Google Cloud Storage →
setup/install-gcp-gs.bat
S3-compatible object storage →
setup/install-compat-s3.bat
When the form screen appears, enter your authentication information and click
Create
.
Run
mount.bat
from the displayed Explorer directory to mount the storage.
Access the bucket files through Windows Explorer.
Run
un-mount.bat
to unmount the drive.

• **争议焦点**：主要争议在于两者在不同使用场景下的适用性以及用户的个人偏好，特别是在功能需求、平台兼容性和易用性方面的考虑。

data.article_summary: 本文讨论了如何在写作中有效运用逻辑构建论证，强调仅仅理解逻辑三段论并不足以构建有力的书面论证。文章建议在将逻辑三段论转化为书面论证时，应清晰陈述每个前提、为每个前提提供证据，并明确展示与结论的关联。文章通过两个例子说明：一个是反对使用纳税人的钱建设新体育场的论证，通过详细阐述和证据支持每个前提，得出有力结论；另一个是关于提高最低工资的论证失败案例，指出其缺乏逻辑结构和证据支持。文章强调，逻辑论证需要精心安排，才能使其具有说服力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同话题的逻辑分析与论证方法，包括艺术与足球的资助辩论、最低工资与就业的关系，以及通过名人进行宣传的策略。

不同观点：
• [keiferski] 认为学习符号逻辑（或命题逻辑）有助于将论证形式化并评估其有效性，这比直接从英文文本中判断论证的有效性更容易。他推荐了Klenk的《Understanding Symbolic Logic》作为参考书。

• [nthingtohide] 通过《Yes Minister》中的一段经典对话分析了艺术与足球资助的辩论。部长认为公共艺术补贴主要使中产阶级受益，主张资助大众更关心的项目如足球和电影。而Sir Humphrey则捍卫传统观点，认为艺术补贴对文化保存和教育有重要作用。对话的讽刺结局揭示了政治言论与个人行为之间的差距。

• [ogogmad] 对最低工资与就业的关系提出质疑，认为“价格上升则购买减少”的经济模型过于简单化，无法全面解释现实中的经济现象，如需求无弹性、反馈回路等复杂因素。

• [riehwvfbk] 提出了一种不同的策略，即通过名人诽谤支持或反对某项目（如体育场建设）的人，认为这种方法更快更有效。

补充讨论：
• 艺术与足球资助的争议焦点在于公共资金的使用方向以及文化保存与大众娱乐之间的平衡。
• 符号逻辑被视为分析和评估论证有效性的有用工具。
• 最低工资与就业的关系涉及复杂的经济模型和多变量的相互作用，简单的线性推理可能不足以解释现实情况。
• 名人效应在舆论和政治策略中的应用被提及作为一个快速有效的策略。

这些观点展示了逻辑分析、经济理论和政治策略的多样性和复杂性，以及不同论证方法和视角的重要性。

Understanding how to create logical syllogisms does not automatically mean that writers understand how to use logic to build an argument. Crafting a logical sequence into a written argument can be a very difficult task. Don't assume that an audience will easily follow the logic that seems clear to you. When converting logical syllogisms into written arguments, remember to:
lay out each premise clearly
provide evidence for each premise
draw a clear connection to the conclusion
Say a writer was crafting an editorial to argue against using taxpayer dollars for the construction of a new stadium in the town of Mill Creek. The author's logic may look like this:
Premise 1:
Projects funded by taxpayer dollars should benefit a majority of the public.
Premise 2:
The proposed stadium construction benefits very few members of the public.
Conclusion:
Therefore, the stadium construction should not be funded by taxpayer dollars.
This is a logical conclusion, but without elaboration it may not persuade the writer's opposition, or even people on the fence. Therefore, the writer will want to expand her argument like this:
Historically, Mill Creek has only funded public projects that benefit the population as a whole. Recent initiatives to build a light rail system and a new courthouse were approved because of their importance to the city. Last election, Mayor West reaffirmed this commitment in his inauguration speech by promising "I am determined to return public funds to the public." This is a sound commitment and a worthy pledge.
However, the new initiative to construct a stadium for the local baseball team, the Bears, does not follow this commitment. While baseball is an enjoyable pastime, it does not receive enough public support to justify spending $210 million in public funds for an improved stadium. Attendance in the past five years has been declining, and last year only an average of 400 people attended each home game, meaning that less than 1% of the population attends the stadium. The Bears have a dismal record at 0-43 which generates little public interest in the team.
The population of Mill Creek is plagued by many problems that affect the majority of the public, including its decrepit high school and decaying water filtration system. Based on declining attendance and interest, a new Bears stadium is not one of those needs, so the project should not be publicly funded. Funding this project would violate the mayor's commitment to use public money for the public.
Notice that the piece uses each paragraph to focus on one premise of the syllogism (this is not a hard and fast rule, especially since complex arguments require far more than three premises and paragraphs to develop). Concrete evidence for both premises is provided. The conclusion is specifically stated as following from those premises.
Consider this example, where a writer wants to argue that the state minimum wage should be increased. The writer does not follow the guidelines above when making his argument.
It is obvious to anyone thinking logically that minimum wage should be increased. The current minimum wage is an insult and is unfair to the people who receive it. The fact that the last proposed minimum wage increase was denied is proof that the government of this state is crooked and corrupt. The only way for them to prove otherwise is to raise minimum wage immediately.
The paragraph does not build a logical argument for several reasons. First, it assumes that anyone thinking logically will already agree with the author, which is clearly untrue. If that were the case, the minimum wage increase would have already occurred. Secondly, the argument does not follow a logical structure. There is no development of premises which lead to a conclusion. Thirdly, the author provides no evidence for the claims made.
In order to develop a logical argument, the author first needs to determine the logic behind his own argument. It is likely that the writer did not consider this before writing, which demonstrates that arguments which could be logical are not automatically logical. They must be made logical by careful arrangement.
The writer could choose several different logical approaches to defend this point, such as a syllogism like this:
Premise 1:
Minimum wage should match the cost of living in society.
Premise 2:
The current minimum wage does not match the cost of living in society.
Conclusion:
Therefore, minimu

data.title: An AI-generated summer reading list got published in major newspapers
data.author: Michelangelo11
data.article_summary: 多家美国报纸，包括《芝加哥太阳时报》和《费城问询报》的某个版本，刊登了一份由人工智能生成的夏季阅读书单，其中包含多本知名作家的虚假书籍。例如，伊莎贝尔·阿连德并未写过名为《潮水梦》的书。这份书单由King Features提供，是 syndicated 内容的一部分。书单中的15本书只有5本是真实的，错误引发了读者和作家的不满。芝加哥太阳时报的营销总监表示正在调查此事，并强调他们重视读者的信任。《芝加哥太阳时报》此前因财政困难进行了裁员，这一事件反映了媒体行业依赖AI生成内容的问题。NPR书籍贡献者Gabino Iglesias指出，目前美国全职书评人数量稀少，强调应支付作家报酬以保护其作品不受AI影响。

How an AI-generated summer reading list got published in major newspapers
May 20, 2025
3:07 PM ET
Elizabeth Blair
A syndicated, AI-generated summer reading list featuring fake books by real authors was published in major newspapers this week. Above, a reader enjoys the sunshine in Hyde Park in London in 2009.
Oli Scarff/Getty Images
hide caption
toggle caption
Oli Scarff/Getty Images
Some newspapers around the country, including the
Chicago Sun-Times
and at least one edition of
The Philadelphia Inquirer
have published
a syndicated summer book list
that includes made-up books by famous authors.
Chilean American novelist Isabel Allende never wrote a book called
Tidewater Dreams
, described in the "Summer reading list for 2025" as the author's "first climate fiction novel."
Books We Love
17 new books our critics can't wait to read this summer
Percival Everett, who won the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for fiction, never wrote a book called
The Rainmakers
, supposedly set in a "near-future American West where artificially induced rain has become a luxury commodity."
Only five of the 15 titles on the list are real.
Ray Bradbury, who coincidentally hated computers,
did
write
Dandelion Wine
, Jess Walter wrote
Beautiful Ruin
s
and Françoise Sagan
penned
the classic
Bonjour Tristesse.
According to Victor Lim, marketing director for the
Chicago Sun-Times'
parent company Chicago Public Media, the list was part of licensed content provided by King Features, a unit of the publisher Hearst Newspapers.
Sponsor Message
The list has no byline. But writer Marco Buscaglia has claimed responsibility for it and says it was partly generated by Artificial Intelligence, as
first reported by the website 404 Media.
In an email to NPR, Buscaglia writes, "Huge mistake on my part and has nothing to do with the
Sun-Times
. They trust that the content they purchase is accurate and I betrayed that trust. It's on me 100 percent."
Yep- the bogus summer reading list from the Chicago Sun Times is real. Here I am with it from a few minutes ago.
(Support your local library!!)
[image or embed]
— Tina Books (
@tbretc.bsky.social
)
May 20, 2025 at 11:01 AM
When one user posted a photo of the list on social media, writers and readers were upset.
"As a subscriber, I am livid!"
xxxlovelit
writes
on Reddit. "What is the point of subscribing to a hard copy paper if they are just going to include AI slop too!?"
On Bluesky, author, former librarian and Book Riot editor Kelly Jensen
laments
, "This is the future of book recommendations when libraries are defunded and dismantled. Trained professionals are removed in exchange for this made up, inaccurate garbage."
Books We Love
Show up to your next book club meeting with these 12 reading recommendations
"We are looking into how this made it into print as we speak," said a statement given to NPR by Lim. "This is licensed content that was not created by, or approved by, the
Sun-Times
newsroom, but it is unacceptable for any content we provide to our readers to be inaccurate. We value
our readers' trust in our reporting and take this very seriously. More info will be provided soon as we investigate."
The fake summer reading list is dated May 18, two months after the
Chicago Sun-Times
announced
that 20% of its staff had accepted buyouts "as the paper's nonprofit owner, Chicago Public Media, deals with fiscal hardship."
Sponsor Message
For author and NPR Books contributor Gabino Iglesias, the fake book list speaks to the problems plaguing all media these days: "How many full-time book reviewers are there in the U.S.? Very few," he said.
Books We Love
12 novels that NPR critics and staff are excited to share with you
At the same time, Iglesias said there are plenty of people writing or talking about books online and on podcasts.
Iglesias said he's one of the many writers who are trying to
file
a class action lawsuit to protect their work from AI.
He joked that if people really want to read the fake books described on the list, he and plenty of other authors are ready to serve.
"Pay writers, and then we can write these fake books that don't exist," he laughed.
Jennifer Vanasco edited this story.

data.title: Why AI hasn't taken your job – And any jobs-pocalypse seems a long way off
data.author: helsinkiandrew
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了人工智能（AI）的快速发展，尽管AI能完成许多任务，如撰写报告和制作视频，但尚未导致大规模失业。所谓的“就业末日”似乎还很遥远。文章还提到AI模型的幻觉问题正逐渐减少。此外，文章简要提及其他经济与金融新闻，如债券收益率飙升、特朗普威胁加征关税、美国科技巨头面临的脆弱性，以及其他全球经济动态。总体而言，文章强调了AI对就业市场的当前影响有限，同时探讨了全球经济中的若干重要趋势。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI对就业市场的影响及相关数据的解读

不同观点：
• **saithound**认为，《经济学人》等媒体过度强调“AI不会取代你的工作”的论调，忽视了实际正在发生的就业市场变化。他指出，虽然官方数据可能显示某些行业（如翻译）的就业人数增加，但这些数据忽略了实际收入下降的问题。他还通过其伴侣在大学行政部门工作的例子，说明计算机工程毕业生在六个月内就业率大幅下降，暗示就业市场正在快速恶化。

• **dunkeltaenzer**承认AI确实会取代一些实际工作的岗位，但他认为很多工作本质上是“无意义的工作”（Bullshit jobs），这些工作并不是为了实际产出，而是为了维持某种职业身份和社会地位。AI不会取代这些工作，因为这些工作依赖于人类的情绪和自我认同感。然而，AI会让这些无意义的工作更加显而易见，并可能优化掉这些岗位，从而暴露当前就业体系中的问题。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点**在于AI对就业市场的实际影响以及如何解读相关数据。saithound认为官方数据具有误导性，忽视了收入和就业质量的下降，而dunkeltaenzer则关注工作性质本身，提出很多工作本质上是无意义的，AI不会取代这些工作，但会使这些问题更加突出。

• **数据解读的分歧**：saithound批评《经济学人》过度依赖官方数据，忽视了实际收入和就业质量的变化，而dunkeltaenzer则关注工作性质的差异，认为某些工作本质上无法被AI取代。

• **实例支持**：saithound通过其伴侣在大学行政部门的观察，提供了计算机工程毕业生就业率下降的具体例子，而dunkeltaenzer则从理论上讨论了“无意义的工作”这一概念，并提出AI会让这些问题更加明显。

整体来看，讨论围绕AI对就业市场的不同影响及其背后的数据解读展开，参与者从不同角度提供了论据和实例。

• **争议的焦点**在于AI对就业市场的实际影响以及如何解读相关数据。saithound认为官方数据具有误导性，忽视了收入和就业质量的下降，而dunkeltaenzer则关注工作性质本身，提出很多工作本质上是无意义的，AI不会取代这些工作，但会使这些问题更加突出。

• **数据解读的分歧**：saithound批评《经济学人》过度依赖官方数据，忽视了实际收入和就业质量的变化，而dunkeltaenzer则关注工作性质的差异，认为某些工作本质上无法被AI取代。

• **实例支持**：saithound通过其伴侣在大学行政部门的观察，提供了计算机工程毕业生就业率下降的具体例子，而dunkeltaenzer则从理论上讨论了“无意义的工作”这一概念，并提出AI会让这些问题更加明显。

整体来看，讨论围绕AI对就业市场的不同影响及其背后的数据解读展开，参与者从不同角度提供了论据和实例。
