Firefox
Firefox 139 adds experimental AI-powered Link Previews, here’s how to try it
Marcus Mendes
| May 27 2025 - 3:24 pm PT
4 Comments
Today, Mozilla released Firefox 139.0, which brings an interesting AI-based feature: by pressing a keyboard shortcut, the browser opens a small pop-up with a preview of a link’s content. Here’s how to test it out.
A bit of context
Browsers are quickly becoming the next battleground for AI features. While companies like Perplexity work on the much-anticipated Comet, some more traditional players have started rolling out their own ideas of what a browser in the AI era should look like.
Recently, Google
announced
plans to integrate Gemini directly into Chrome, letting users interact with its LLM about the contents of any page.
Microsoft, meanwhile, says it will
allow
websites to access a local AI model in Edge to offer features like summarization and, eventually, translation.
Even Apple has implemented AI-based summaries in Safari, although they’re only accessible from Reader Mode, making them a bit inconvenient to use.
Link previews
Now, Mozilla has released Firefox 139.0 with Link Previews, an experimental AI feature that summarizes the key points of a webpage before you click on its link.
As Mozilla
explains
it:
“Link Previews is currently available as an experimental feature which can be enabled via Firefox Labs in the Firefox settings. After enabling, use the Alt+Shift keyboard shortcut when hovering over a link to see the previews in action!”
This feature was
first announced
las month as part of Firefox Labs 138, but it’s now more widely available. While it raises the usual questions about how AI previews might affect website traffic, this kind of low-key AI feature can make browsing feel faster and more useful to technical and non-technical users alike.

data.title: Fake discounts on Shein 'breach law', EU says
data.author: donohoe
data.article_summary: 欧盟表示，中国快时尚网站Shein上的虚假折扣、压力销售等行为违反了法律。欧盟已要求Shein在一个月内回应调查结果，否则将面临罚款。调查发现Shein存在误导信息、虚假价格减免、隐藏联系方式以及虚假产品评价等问题。欧盟司法专员Michael McGrath强调，所有面向欧盟消费者的公司必须遵守规则。Shein则表示正与欧盟积极合作，以确保符合法律要求。此前，Shein还因劳工问题和棉花来源问题受到批评。
data.comments_summary: 暂无评论

44112659.article_content:
Fake discounts on Shein 'breach law', EU says
2 days ago
Share
Save
Mitchell Labiak
Business reporter, BBC News
Share
Save
Getty Images
Fake discounts, pressure selling, and other practices on Chinese fast-fashion website Shein breach the law, the European Union (EU) has said.
The bloc said it has given Shein one month to respond to its findings or face fines based on its sales in the EU countries where it says it has breached the law.
"It's now for Shein to step up, respect the rules and bring its practices fully in line with EU consumer standards," said EU justice commissioner Michael McGrath.
A Shein spokesperson said: "Our priority remains ensuring that European consumers can have a safe, reliable, and enjoyable online shopping experience."
The EU said on Monday its ongoing investigation from the EU's consumer rights enforcer found "a broad range of practices with which consumers are confronted while shopping on Shein and that are in breach of EU law".
This included misleading information, deceptive product labels, misleading sustainability claims, and hidden contact details.
It also found instances of pretending to offer better deals by showing price reductions that were not based on the actual prior prices, and fake deadlines to put consumers under pressure to buy.
The EU has also asked Shein to make sure its product reviews and ratings are "not presented to consumers in a misleading manner".
"All companies reaching out to EU consumers must play by our rules. Today's action sends a clear message: we will not shy away from holding e-commerce platforms to account, regardless of where they are based," said McGrath.
A Shein spokesperson said it has been "working constructively with national consumers authorities and the EU Commission to demonstrate our commitment to complying with EU laws and regulations, and we are continuing to engage in this process to address any concerns".
Shein backlash
Shein has come under fire for its business practices before, with
a January BBC report revealing some staff were working 75-hour weeks
, in breach of Chinese labour laws.
That same month, Shein was accused of
"wilful ignorance" by MPs in the UK
after its lawyer repeatedly refused to answer questions about where the retailer sources its cotton.
In response to the BBC investigation into worker conditions, Shein said it is "committed to ensuring the fair and dignified treatment of all workers within our supply chain", and that it is investing tens of millions of dollars in strengthening governance and compliance.
"We strive to set the highest standards for pay and we require that all supply chain partners adhere to our code of conduct," it said.

data.title: Intel versus AMD is currently an emotional decision for me
data.author: goranmoomin
data.article_summary: 本文解释了为何一些用户在访问Wandering Thoughts博客或CSpace时被阻止。原因是网站采取了反爬虫措施，自动屏蔽了使用过时浏览器（尤其是旧版Chrome）的访问者，以应对2025年初大量使用旧浏览器用户代理的高流量爬虫，这些爬虫常被用于收集LLM训练数据。如果用户确实在使用最新浏览器但仍被阻止，可以联系作者。此外，文章特别提到archive.*网站（如archive.today等）的爬虫行为与恶意爬虫类似，建议使用更为规范的archive.org进行存档。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对Intel和AMD芯片的选择以及对不同架构的看法

不同观点：
• sherr：认为Intel的主要优势在于开源图形驱动，特别适合长期使用Linux的用户，无需担心内核升级后的图形驱动问题。
• g42gregory：提出Apple Silicon可能是解决选择困境的方案，暗示苹果芯片可能是另一种选择。
• esseph：5年前还考虑Intel，但现在尽量避免选择Intel，除非特定问题限制了选择，比如供应商只有少数AMD SKU。
• adrian_b：虽然不喜欢Intel的一些商业决策，但选择CPU是基于技术需求而非情感。特别强调需要AVX-512支持，认为Intel在低功耗领域仍有优势，但Lunar Lake的BUG使其转向ARM方案。
• nan60：认为Intel近几年的芯片表现不佳，特别不喜欢P-core和E-core架构，以及为提升功耗效率而做出的妥协，作为Linux用户体验不佳。
• darthrupert：最近购买了x1 carbon，对电池寿命和整体性能表示满意，除了从睡眠中唤醒时的频率提升问题。
• hoseja：质疑Intel在单核爆发性能上的优势，并提到AMD的9950X3D作为对比。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是Intel和AMD在不同应用场景下的性能和功耗表现，特别是针对Linux用户和特定技术需求（如AVX-512）的适用性。
• 另一个争议点是Intel的P-core和E-core架构是否有效提升了性能和功耗效率，以及这种架构对不同用户群体（如Linux用户）的影响。
• Apple Silicon被视为Intel和AMD之外的另一种选择，特别是在解决性能和功耗问题上可能提供新的思路。
• 对特定技术特性（如MONITOR/MWAIT）的依赖和其在不同架构上的实现情况也是用户选择CPU时的重要考虑因素。

44113127.article_content:
You're using a suspiciously old browser
You're probably reading this page because you've attempted to access
some part of
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
or
CSpace
, the wiki thing it's part of. Unfortunately
you're using a browser version that my anti-crawler precautions consider
suspicious, most often because it's too old (most often this applies to
versions of Chrome). Unfortunately, as of early 2025 there's a plague
of high volume crawlers (apparently in part to gather data for LLM
training) that use a variety of old browser user agents, especially
Chrome user agents. To reduce the load on
Wandering Thoughts
I'm experimenting with
(attempting to) block all of them, and you've run into this.
If this is in error and you're using a current version of your
browser of choice, you can contact me at
my current place at the
university
(you should be able to work out the email address
from that). If possible, please let me know what browser you're
using and so on, ideally with its exactl User-Agent string.
A special note for people using archive.*
You may be seeing this through archive.today, archive.ph, archive.is,
and so on. Unfortunately, archive.* crawls pages to archive in a way that
is impossible to distinguish from malicious actors. They use old Chrome
User-Agent values, crawl from IP address blocks that are widely distributed
and not clearly identified as theirs, and some of their IP addresses have
falsified reverse DNS entries that claim they are googlebot IP addresses
(which is something that is normally done only by quite bad actors). I
suggest that you use archive.org, which is a better behaved archival
crawler and can crawl
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
.
Chris Siebenmann, 2025-02-17

data.title: Owls in Towels
data.author: schaum
data.article_summary: 野生动物救助者常将猫头鹰用布包裹起来，以便称重、治疗和喂食，这导致网上出现大量#猫头鹰裹布#的可爱照片。文章展示了多个实例，如心形脸盘的北部锯磨猫头鹰"Rocket"、台湾的山地角鸮、以及东部尖叫猫头鹰"Coda"等。其他案例包括康复中的北部鹰鸮、患有斜颈的强大猫头鹰、以及从窗口碰撞中恢复的Ruru等。这些照片展示了猫头鹰在救助过程中的各种状态，突显了救助工作的细致和重要性。同时，文章还强调了救助设施的优质和长达20多年的野生动物护理经验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕网站"Owls in Towels"的多种观点和讨论

不同观点：
• 正面赞赏：
   - 该网站提醒人们，即使拥有简单技术的个人也能为关心的事业做出贡献（第一条评论）。
   - 网站唤起了早期互联网的氛围，充满了对特定事物的热情和分享（josh-sematic, mortenjorck）。
   - 网站设计精美，照片质量高，体现出精心策划（kristopolous）。
   - 网站的FAQ页面充满奇思妙想，令人喜爱（susam）。
   - 网站内容令人愉悦，特别是因为其独特的动物主题（cogogo, uneekname）。

• 个人经验分享：
   - pierreC分享了在野生动物收容所做志愿者的经历，特别是处理受伤鸟类的具体方法和挑战。
   - hungmung提供了处理误入家中的鸟类和蝙蝠的实用建议。

• 对互联网文化的反思：
   - ttoinou提出对未来AI生成内容可能淹没真实内容的担忧。

• 幽默与轻松评论：
   - lenerdenator将猫和猫的卷饼与猫头鹰作比较，调侃猫头鹰不能说话。
   - ColinWright对网站的结束语“That's owl the posts”表示赞赏，认为这是他当天需要的网络内容。

• 技术性联想：
   - tharakam误以为网站与语义网技术有关，链接到了W3C的OWL页面。
   - 0xDEAFBEAD幽默地问道，老鼠对该网站会有什么看法。

补充讨论：
• 网站与社交媒体账号的关系：uneekname提到该网站可能与fediverse上的某个账号由同一群人运营。
• 对网站的直接反馈：ayrtondesozzla对网站的体验表示高度赞赏，使用了“A+ FACILITIES WOULD STAY AGAIN”这样的调侃语气。

争议焦点：
• 对AI生成内容可能影响互联网独特小站点的担忧（ttoinou的观点），但其他评论并未直接回应这一问题。
